entry.title: Rockstar Publishing Max Payne Remake, Ends Questions To Remedy
entry.summary:
Fans were hoping to get a small update on the Max Payne Remake from Remedy on Tuesday as part of their quarterly update to investors. However, whilst we have heard things about the game in documents for investors in the past, there was almost no update and Remedy shut down questions about it. On Tuesday [...]

entry.title: The Voice of The Witcher's Geralt Says He'd Sue Every Single AI Platform With His Voice on It 'Into the Ground' if He Could
entry.summary: Doug Cockle, the voice behind The Witcher’s Geralt, has hit out at AI platforms that feature his voice, saying he’d sue them if he could.

entry.title: Space Marine 2 Maker Saber Interactive Denies Writer's Claim They Were Replaced by ChatGPT, but Admits Rideshare Stimulator Will Feature AI 'By Necessity'
entry.summary: Saber Interactive, the company behind Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, has denied it replaced a writer with ChatGPT, but admitted its new taxi game Rideshare Stimulator uses AI "by necessity."

entry.title: Disney Confirms D23 Kingdom Hearts Panel Details, and Given Who's on It, We're Expecting Kingdom Hearts 4 News
entry.summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 news looks set for later this week after Disney confirmed the details of its Kingdom Hearts panel at fan convention D23.
